items.title: OpenAI releases GPT-6.1 Terra, a lower-cost long-context model
problems: The item says OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Terra on 26 October, but neither readable source dates OpenAI's release; AWS says it announced Bedrock general availability.
The item says teams could previously use GPT-6.1 Sol and Luna and had no Terra tier, but neither readable source mentions Luna or establishes that prior state.
